title: Secure AI-assisted plant image triage foundation
changes: Added a server-side /api/diagnose endpoint using configurable OpenAI-compatible multimodal providers.
Added plant image analysis UI with symptom metadata, differential candidates, evidence gaps, safe next steps, and uncertainty notes.
Added server-only environment configuration: AI_API_KEY, AI_BASE_URL, AI_MODEL.
Added strict image MIME/size validation, no-store response headers, sanitized structured output, and no chemical dosage recommendations.
Diagnosis records can save the analysis result locally alongside the image and symptoms.
not_enabled_until_configured: Live AI analysis requires a compatible multimodal provider, valid environment variables, and deployment of serverless functions.
No provider or model has been selected or activated by the user yet.
